purpose: Final targeted generic-only A/B for Order 108 hypothesis 3 after preserving and auditing the v99 failure.
change_scope: Carry forward generic PDF layout compaction and the direct new-workbook facade, then make the reusable Calc workbook lifecycle reliable: stage and validate replacements before commit, restore an existing workbook after failed overwrite, orient flat values from a one-column A1 target, expose spreadsheet.save for explicit persistence, and derive completion artifact evidence from successful model-selected output paths instead of treating every instruction filename as an output.

implementation_evidence.parent_diagnosis: v99 made spreadsheet.create_workbook directly discoverable and Qwen selected it to create the requested Desktop workbook. The model then used flat values for one-column ranges, searched for a save action that the Multi-Apps facade did not expose, and retried overwrite. The existing create_new implementation deleted the prior valid file before a failed replacement, so evaluator artifact fetch ended in 404. Completion evidence also treated source PDFs as requested outputs and did not recognize the create result as saved output evidence.
implementation_evidence.counterfactual_scope: Synthetic inventory and weather workbooks prove two-phase creation, old-file restoration after a corrupting final-store failure, and cleanup of staged artifacts. Unrelated rainfall data proves deterministic flat-list orientation for a vertical C3:C5 range. A coastal workbook proves spreadsheet.save forwards either no arguments or the exact model-selected output path. A source-a/source-b completion test proves model-selected output evidence excludes input filenames and requires an explicit save after a later write.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The model still selects every spreadsheet.create_workbook, spreadsheet.write_range, spreadsheet.save, and completion call and supplies every model-facing argument. A1 geometry deterministically normalizes a flat list only when the explicit target is one column; no value is inferred. The Adapter never consults task identity, dataset order, instruction fingerprints, evaluator state, golden files, expected values, filenames, years, institutions, or fixed cells.
